title: Drunk 18-Year-Old Girl Completely Loses It During Arrest
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 2, 2022, police were downtown on foot patrol when a fight broke out between two males outside a bar in Stevens Point, WI. A female then suddenly intervened and allegedly was defending her cousin involved. Police attempted to restrain her as she tried to go after the other male but she was uncooperative. Once they placed her in the squad car, she goes complete haywire. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
